parameters.content:
# ShiftHub — Seed Demo Data (run once)

Populates the Rota tab with a realistic SIWES demo set:

- SHIFT-DEMO-01: starts in ~3h10m, nobody confirmed — the exact case the 3-hour supervisor alert exists for
- SHIFT-DEMO-05: starts in ~2h10m, one still to confirm — the case the 2-hour reminder exists for
- tomorrow + next-week + last-month rows for the other workflows

Run manually after connecting the Google Sheets credential. Then execute workflow 03 straight away (you have ~25 minutes of headroom; re-seed if you are later than that). Clear the Rota tab first if you re-seed. Do not use in production.

nodes.name: Build Seed Rows
nodes.notes: Relative-date demo rows; token is random per row.

nodes.notes: Appends the demo assignments to the Rota tab.
